cases.purpose: Compare every numeric threshold and canonical level name against util-linux on the live kernel; check capability denial and status-2 invalid arguments before syslog with a positive seccomp control. Restore the initial console threshold.
cases.oracle: Live util-linux for valid levels; explicit candidate status and seccomp contract for errors.
cases.candidate_script:
set +e
read -r original _ < /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
restore() { printf '%s\n' "$original" > /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125; }
trap restore EXIT
printf '7\n' > /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
for arg in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 emerg alert crit err warn notice info debug; do
  printf '7\n' > /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
  /usr/bin/dmesg -n "$arg" >/tmp/dmesg-console-ref.out 2>/tmp/dmesg-console-ref.err || exit 125
  read -r ref _ < /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
  printf '7\n' > /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
  dmesg -n "$arg" >/tmp/dmesg-console.out 2>/tmp/dmesg-console.err || exit 1
  read -r got _ < /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
  [[ $got == "$ref" && ! -s /tmp/dmesg-console.out && ! -s /tmp/dmesg-console.err ]] || exit 1
done
printf '6\n' > /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
/usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 --clear-groups -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'dmesg -n 4' >/tmp/dmesg-console.out 2>/tmp/dmesg-console.err
rc=$?
read -r got _ < /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
[[ $rc == 1 && $got == 6 && -s /tmp/dmesg-console.err && ! -s /tmp/dmesg-console.out ]] || exit 1
sec=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-seccomp.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$sec" --kill syslog -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'dmesg -n 4' >/tmp/dmesg-console.out 2>/tmp/dmesg-console.err
[[ $? == 159 ]] || exit 125
for arg in bogus 9 '' ; do
  /usr/bin/python3 "$sec" --kill syslog -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'dmesg -n "$1"' _ "$arg" >/tmp/dmesg-console.out 2>/tmp/dmesg-console.err
  rc=$?
  [[ $rc == 2 && -s /tmp/dmesg-console.err && ! -s /tmp/dmesg-console.out ]] || exit 1
done
/usr/bin/python3 "$sec" --kill syslog -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'dmesg -n' >/tmp/dmesg-console.out 2>/tmp/dmesg-console.err
rc=$?
[[ $rc == 2 && -s /tmp/dmesg-console.err && ! -s /tmp/dmesg-console.out ]] || exit 1
read -r got _ < /proc/sys/kernel/printk || exit 125
[[ $got == 6 ]] || exit 1
printf 'PASS\n'
